caption:
Memory lane with my baby bump. 🥹🤰🏽

As I nest in our little love bubble with Matisse and Kevin at home and get adjusted to our new life with him, I will be sharing photos I never posted before with my babybump and from last years summer in Europe as I won’t be creating new content right now as I take some time away to be with my little family and enjoy these beginning moments with him. 🥹❤️🫶🏽 

It’s been so beautiful experiencing motherhood for these last three weeks and feeling this love that we’ve never felt before for this precious little human we created. We are truly, madly, deeply in love with him! Can’t even remember how life was before him, because nothing else matters anymore but our little baby Matisse 👶🏽 

Although we are loving every second with him, it hasn’t been all that easy at times. We’ve had our rough nights here and there with little to no sleep with him struggling to eat or sleep but nothing we can’t handle. Overall though, we are good, happy and healthy… just trying to get the hang of things! There’s things we don’t know and are learning along the way but thankfully we have the best family and friends to help and support us during this new journey in our lives! 

Thank you guys for the love and hope you enjoy the content I never posted before until I’m back with new stuff soon for you! 

Now I’m off to enjoy my little cute bundle of joy ! Xx

caption:
As the clock struck midnight to ring in 2022, I cried that ‘this will be the worst year ever’. 

Kalu, my fur bestie of 18 years, had just been given weeks to live after a terminal cancer diagnosis. How could 2022 ever recover from that?

Yet somehow it came pretty close.

It was a year of ‘ands’… of grieving and landing dream collaborations 💃🏽, of limiting beliefs and growing my jewellery brand @thetreasurededit 💫, of anxieties and saying yes to packing up our lives and moving across the world 🇺🇸. Thank you for supporting me through it all 🫶🏾.

As we welcome 2023 from our new home in San Francisco I couldn’t be further (emotionally and literally 😅) from the person I was.

Scary…AND freeing 🤍.

My 2023 intention is to lean into play and adventure, leading with a ‘what if it all works out?’ mindset.

Excited to share the ride with you all, thank you for following along 🥰

Happy New Year 🥳

T xx

caption:
I used to think how can I make a difference? I am just one person in this enormous world and there is just too much to do, but early on I understood that to amplify change it is essential to join forces and that trough dedication and collaboration everything is possible. From the bottom of my heart, I want to thank everyone who was at the Luz Alliance Gala yesterday, helping us to support nature. Together we were able to raise funds that will be help so many people and projects in Brazil. A special thanks to the amazing @ivetesangalo , @robinrobertsgma , @ingridsilva and @brazilfound . 
As Desmond Tutu said: “Do your little bit of good where you are; it's those little bits of good put together that overwhelm the world.” ❤️🙏✨ 

Costumava pensar: Como posso fazer a diferença? Sou apenas uma pessoa neste mundo enorme e há tanto para ser feito, mas desde cedo percebi que para amplificar a mudança é fundamental unir forças e que através da dedicação e colaboração, tudo é possível. Do fundo do coração, quero agradecer a todos os que estiveram ontem na Gala da Luz Alliance, ajudando-nos a apoiar a natureza. Juntos conseguimos arrecadar fundos que vão ajudar muitas pessoas e projetos no Brasil. Um agradecimento especial às incríveis @IveteSangalo, @RobinRobertsGMA, @IngridSilva e @brazilfound.
Como disse Desmond Tutu: “Faça o seu pouco de bem onde você estiver; são esses pequenos pedaços de bem juntos que inundam o mundo.”

Nature doesn’t judge or divide. She nurtures. She reminds us that every form of life is sacred, and important, and has its own special role in creating balance, so all of life can flourish.
Nature has the answers--and by observing her, and mirroring back her example, we can all thrive.
This is our home, and our choices create our future.

caption: Short embroidered dress #zarawoman

Last year I was fortunate enough to visit the @maisonmargiela atelier in Paris before it closed down. The building, a former convent in the 11th, I knew by heart from documentaries and books. Furniture covered in white fabric, white paint splatter everywhere from when Martin and his team first moved in. 
This season I was invited to the House’s new (and much bigger) HQ in the 16th. It may not have Martin’s soul, but his legacy lives on. It’s in the white fabric covered chairs at the reception, the tabi shaped footprints directing to the elevators, his bottle lamps with blank labels. 
But the new HQ also has John Galliano written all over it. To celebrate the move, the basement atelier was turned into an art installation inspired by his short film for the latest Artisanal collection called Cinema Inferno. Thanks so much for showing me around @moakarlsvard and for letting me drool over the AW23 collection (and for bombarding you with questions about what it’s like to work for MM as the fashion nerd I am)

POV: you have the new @filippa_k store all to yourself. Obsessing over the icey blue floors, vintage design (the Rougier shell lamp, the Ducaroy for Ligne Roset sofa), and tapestries in the fitting rooms made from leftover yarn from previous collections. caption: Fashion assistant sourcing accessories for my shoot next week ✈️

From planting trees, regenerating springs and depleted soils, and protecting turtles, jaguars … everything impacts nature. The power of nature comes from its diversity, and it depends on it for survival.

Every form of life uniquely creates balance on Earth so all of life can flourish.
Like with people, our differences are also our strengths, and we get stronger when we work together.
Last year, I started a project called Biomes to help regenerate the biodiversity of Brazil.

From north to south, east to west, we selected seven projects in different regions of the country.
Each biome's species have an important role in nature because everything is connected.

Now, together with The Luz Alliance Fund in partnership with @brazilfound on Saturday, May 20th in Miami, we are having a dinner to raise more funds to expand our efforts and have a more significant impact. 💚 

Seja através do plantio de árvores, regeneração de nascentes e solos degradados, ou proteção de tartarugas, onças… temos tentado ajudar de diferentes formas, pois tudo impacta a natureza. O poder da natureza vem de sua diversidade e depende dela para sua sobrevivência. Cada forma de vida desempenha um papel especial no equilíbrio da Terra, possibilitando que todas as formas de vida possam prosperar. Assim como acontece com as pessoas, nossas diferenças também são nossos pontos fortes, e ficamos mais fortes quando trabalhamos juntos.

No ano passado, iniciei um projeto chamado Biomas para ajudar a regenerar a biodiversidade do Brasil. De norte a sul, de leste a oeste, selecionamos 7 projetos em diferentes regiões do país porque sabemos da importância que cada bioma tem no todo, pois tudo está interligado.

Agora, juntamente com @brazilfound, no dia 20 de maio, em Miami, teremos um jantar para arrecadar mais fundos para que possamos ampliar nossos esforços e ter um impacto ainda maior.

My go-to steps for cosy layers:

BASE: cotton tee + fleecy or thermal tights. Cosy and breathable layer next to the skin.

MID: loose knit. Adds warmth and balances the fitted tights at the bottom.

OUTER: coat with print/colour to compliment the neutral base. The clean lines of the coat add a bit of polish.

SHOES: Personal preference is sneakers (white or detailed). My converse high tops fit warm thick socks 🙌🏾

Let me know if you try this 😘

I understand the fact that your children will be your successors in your business so, they have to be specially eduacated for it.
However, being exposed to social media so much, and exposing your personal life too, is a decision that each and everyone of us has to take for themselves exclusively.
As a result, exposing my minor childrens’ every day life minute by minute on Instagram and tic toc just to promote my business and increase my number of followers is a TORALLY wrong practise. Because firstly I do not take into account their opinion in the matter since they are too small to talk on the matter and evaluate its pros and cons and secondly, when having such a large number of followers, it is practically not humanly possible to know all of them and their intentions for following my profile. 
It is therefore also dangerous to expose my child’s pictures from the beach, from the house, from when taking a bath, etc. to so many millions of people whose intentions I do not really know.

latestIgtvVideos.title: TiNis Ep.11 Colheita
latestIgtvVideos.caption:
Nessas últimas 11 semanas, tive a chance de contar um pouco mais sobre a minha relação com a Natureza e como ela faz parte do dia a dia da minha família. Fico tão feliz de ver como essa iniciativa, que tanto me encantou, inspirou também outras famílias a estarem um pouco mais perto da Natureza. Conhecemos sementes, preparamos e nutrimos o solo, plantamos, regamos e vimos as plantas crescerem. O momento da colheita não é o fim, e sim uma parte do processo de criar vida e conexão com a Natureza. Uma TiNi aproxima famílias e comunidades e traz benefícios para as pessoas e para a Natureza. Espero que tenham gostado . Me conta aqui o que você mais gostou e o que colheu de mais valioso durante a série. 
Aproveito para agradecer a todo o time que tornou possível que esse conteúdo tão especial chegasse até vocês e a todas família que participaram.
Continue ligado no @tinis.natureza e continue criando vida com a gente! #tinisnatureza #minhatini 🪴💚 
For the past eleven weeks, I had the opportunity to talk about my relationship with nature, and the big role it plays in my family’s life. We learned about seeds, and how to prepare, plant, and nourish the soil, and the importance of water in helping plants grow. Don’t forget that the moment we call “harvest” isn’t the end! It’s just one more step in the process of creating life and increasing the connection we have with nature. 
A TiNi brings families and communities together and enriches everybody--including nature! I am thrilled that this initiative has inspired other families to think about their own relationship with the earth. I hope you will tell me what you liked best in the series, and what resonated the most for you.
Finally, I want to thank the entire team that made it possible for this very special content to reach you--and a big thanks to all the families that participated!
Stay tuned to @tinis.natureza and keep creating life with us!

latestIgtvVideos.title: TiNis Ep.4 Aprendendo com a Vida.
latestIgtvVideos.caption:
O que te encanta na Natureza?
O que acho mais incrível é a diversidade da natureza. São tantas cores, sabores, aromas, cada animal, cada planta, distintas paisagens e climas, pores do sol… enfim tudo nela me encanta. Ela nos ensina que é na diversidade que está nossa força. 
Falo sobre isso com @monica_passarinho, bióloga e educadora, guardiã do propósito de TiNis no Brasil.
Aprenda você também com a TiNis a criar um pedacinho de natureza em casa. Que tal começar uma com suas crianças? Acesse @tinis.natureza e aprenda como. #minhatini  #tininatureza #instaserie 💚🌱 
What do you love most about Nature?
What I find most incredible is the diversity of nature. There are so many colors, flavors, aromas, each animal, each plant, different landscapes and climates ... everything about nature just amazes me. Nature is teaching us that diversity is where our strength lies.
I talk about this with Monica Passarinho ,biologist and educator, guardian of TiNis' purpose in Brazil.
Learn also with TiNis how to create a little piece of nature at home. How about starting one with your kids? Visit @tinis.natureza and learn how.

latestIgtvVideos.title: TiNis Ep.3 O que são TiNis
latestIgtvVideos.caption:
TiNis - a Terra das Crianças, é um projeto idealizado por @joaquinleguia e já está fazendo o maior sucesso em diversos países. Me sinto privilegiada de estar trabalhando com o @institutoalana nesta ideia tão simples e ao mesmo tempo tão grandiosa. A intenção é criar um vínculo das crianças com a terra, para que elas entendam os processos da natureza e possam sentir mais empatia por todas as formas de vida. As TiNis podem ser plantadas em qualquer pedacinho de terra, seja em vasinhos espalhados pela casa ou em pequenos canteiros. Fico muito feliz em poder participar desse projeto que já conseguiu tocar milhares de crianças e jovens. Quer aprender como fazer uma TiNi? Acesse @tinis.natureza 🪴💚 
TiNi, also known as the Children's Land, is a project that was brought to life @joaquinleguia, and has already spread to many countries. TiNi’s mission is to create a stronger bond between children and nature. By understanding the cycles and processes of nature, kids develop more empathy for all forms of life. The TiNis can be planted in any surface, whether in pots scattered around your house or in small beds. I feel so happy and privileged to be working with @institutoalana on such a simple but important idea, one has already had such a positive impact on thousands of young people around the world. Are you interested in learning how to make a TiNi? Visit @tinis.natureza

latestIgtvVideos.title: TiNis Ep.2 Harmonia
latestIgtvVideos.caption:
A minha infância no interior me proporcionou experiências inesquecíveis na natureza que levo até hoje no meu coração. Quando virei mãe, quis muito recriar esses momentos na natureza com meus filhos para que eles também pudessem sentir essa conexão, essa alegria. Fico feliz em poder dividir um pouco desse amor pela natureza com todos vocês através do TINIS. Espero que vocês e suas famílias se juntem a nós no @tinis.natureza e possam usufruir um pouco desta experiência que nos faz tão bem. @institutoalana @mariafarinhafilmsbr #minhatini #tininatureza #instaserie 🌱 💚 
My childhood in the countryside gave me chance to have unforgettable experiences in nature that I still carry in my heart. When I became a mother, I really wanted to recreate these moments in nature with my children so that they could also feel this connection, this joy. I’m happy to share my love for nature with all of you through TiNiS. I hope that you and your families join us on @tinis.natureza and be able to experience a little bit of this connection that makes us feel so good.

caption:
✨Time & Effort ✨

This is NOT a 6 month transformation.
These pictures are 3 years apart. 

After both kids, I thought the only way to lose weight was to run it off. I would run hard intervals for 45 mins a day, a minimum of 6 days a week. I did obviously lose the weight, but I my body still didn’t feel like mine and I was exhausted. 

I started lifting weights about 2 years ago, but nothing really heavy, scared I would bulk up vs slim down. Only the last year and a half I started pushing myself to lift as heavy as I could and increase weight overtime. Plus I added in walking cardio. It was only then I started to finally see and feel a difference! 

Keep going, you’ll be happy you did!

BABY SHOWER CAKE & PATISSERIE STAND🎂🥐 Sharing our cake x pastries details:
I was so in love with our beautiful carrot cake that my go-to cake girl @alanajonesmann made for our special day! I wanted to have baby and Mediterranean/French elements on the cake like croissants, baby bottles, olive branches, oranges, lemons etc- The details were impeccable of each element and I literally screamed when I saw how cute the cake turned out! 🥹

I wanted to have a patisserie stand at the shower and bring a bit of France to LA with all of my favorite French pastries like almond croissants, macarons, eclairs, beignets, baguettes, etc! We had cute to-go boxes for guests to take pastries home as if you were at a French bakery! My favorite pastries in LA are from @bottegalouie so I knew our pastries had to be from there! We built the cute awning and created my dream French Al-fresco patisserie stand! 

Thank you so much to @bottegalouie for all the beautiful pastries and @alanajonesmann for the dreamiest babyshower cake- you guys made my shower a dream come true! I’m over the moon with how everything tasted and turned out! 💛 #babyshower #patisserie #babyshowercake

caption:
The happiest I’ve ever been! 🍋💚

So many questions about my baby shower dress! It was the perfect dress from @the.wolf.gang - it was comfortable, effortless and flattering! Loved how bright and fun the color was with the pop of striped print- it went perfectly with the decor! 🫶🏽 #babyshower #babyshoweroutfit

Hi all!! This is my good friend, Jonathan Kuracina. @works_by_jk 

I am so excited to share he has officially launched his new online Print Shop! He is a mixed media Artist based in Vancouver Canada, but they ship to both Canada and the US, with new countries coming soon. You can purchase his prints, some of which come with hand painted designs on top of the digital image! (Those are limited edition). He offers open edition prints and limited edition prints. Once the limited edition prints are gone, they are gone, so if you like something be sure to grab it!! The shop will be updated periodically throughout the year, including the limited edition drops. 

Jonny and I met in college freshman year and were instant friends. I was lucky enough to get one of his first limited edition pieces a few years ago. He had posted this piece on Instagram and I fell in love with it. I asked if I could buy it and unfortunately he had sold it, little did I know he had sold it to my husband!! 

It has been a pleasure to watch him grow as a person and Artist. Please go check out his page and website, he has some of the coolest work I’ll ever seen and it is exciting to see what he will come up with next!

caption:
BABY SHOWER FOOD & BAR details🧡:

We wanted our guests to enjoy feeling like they were in the Mediterranean/French Coastal with decor, food & styling as well as bringing in some touches of Mexico! It was so fun to put the menu together and everyone raved about how yummy the food was! Of course I had to have my fave food catering company @urbanpalatela for this special shower and can’t tell you how insanely gooood everything tasted and how beautiful the presentation was plus the staff was the icing on the cake! fun fact: they catered my big 30th birthday party! So they’ve done all my special milestones- they’re amazing!) 

A few things on the menu were:
Appetizers: 
* Chicken confit sopes with mole, black bean crema, pickled red onion
* Santa Barbara seabass ceviche, heirloom citrus, avocado, habanero oil 
* Tartine station 
Buffet 
* Orecchiette pasta with Arugula pistou, grilled asparagus, fava beans, English peas, Meyer lemon, chèvre
* Grilled skirt steak with guajillo spice, cilantro lime gremalota x  potatoes
* Pan Seared branzino, roasted baby heirloom tomatoes, rosemary , roasted garlic oil

For the bar, we had tailored drinks made by the sweet girls from @martinigirls which were so refreshing and so good! They’ve also done a few of our parties and they’re the best! We also had aguas frescas because I’m obsessed with having fresh juices- we had Watermelon x Pineapple with Spinach! 🍉

For the furniture & dishware, our good friends from @berbereimports helped bring our vision to life! Their pieces are just incredibly stunning- my backyard is all filled with Berbere pots x furniture! 

For the framed house around the buffet table, which turned out to be such a focal statement scene, my sister @lilylove213 and brother in law @mucio323 came up w the idea and built it out! It framed that little vignette so perfectly! 

For all the floral and table styling; my good friend @dolcetto created such a beautiful, effortless job- I just couldn’t get over how pretty everything looked! 

Food: @urbanpalatela 
Bar: @martinigirls
Frame house: @lilylove213 @mucio323 
Furniture x Dishes: @Berbereimports
Florals: @Dolcetto 

#babyshower #babyshowerideas

caption:
BABY SHOWER DECOR DETAILS 🍊😍

Wanted to wrap up my dream babyshower with decor and details! As you can see, the theme was Mediterranean French Coastal with oranges and lemons being a statement throughout the shower! We are obsessed with spending our summers in France so we wanted to bring that South of France feel to our family & friends at the shower to help celebrate Bebé Berru! There was certain touches from my Mexican culture that I knew I wanted to be part of our shower like the big bright piñatas and some yummy traditional food like the mini sopes and aguas frescas. It was so fun mixing both of our cultures together into this special celebration and we loved how everything turned out! We put so much love and work into every detail but we couldn't have possibly made it happen without our family and friends who helped us bring this to life.

To my siblings and brother in laws  @lilylove213 @ari.sari.loves @josesarinana @mucio323 @frankeli29 , thank you so much for everything; for all the planning you did with me and figuring out how to build some of the pieces to your love and support! We love you so much!

To my Bestie @iademunster for putting together all the activities - everything turned out so cute! Ily.

To my boys Erick @maison_trouvaille and Wyman @wymanchang for hosting our shower at their beautiful home; it was truly the most beautiful backdrop to complement our theme! We will never forget this!

To my friend Cece @dolcetto for all the beautiful floral arrangements with lemons + oranges and everything else you helped me with! You're the best cece!

We will remember this day forever! I will be posting more photos that didn’t make it into these IGs posts onto my blog so stay tuned! 

Photography by @elli_lauren #babyshower #babyshowerideas
